desc:
Like the game & Join the group for a free reward!

(ROBLOX PLUS GAINS 20% MORE MONEY)
Every night the power dies at St. Valgrigia. Something walks the corridors... and it can hear you.

Team up with up to 6 players, sneak through an abandoned psychiatric hospital and escape before dawn. Restore the power, find the gate code, open the gate. And never trust a voice on the radio: the creature can copy your friends.

- Hide in lockers, crouch past it, keep your torch charged
- Taken? Your team can pick the lock to free you, but the monster hears the padlock fall
- Talk on the walkie. The monster listens (voice chat optional)
- 7 classes, each with its own edge
- Earn cash every night: torches, outfits, emotes and more
- Escape to unlock harder nights that pay more

Listen for the static.
 
📱 FULL PHONE & TABLET SUPPORT
🖥️ PC
🎮 CONSOLE

Voice actor : @WOAHGUCCIBOY
